initialExam.title: India Post Postman/Mail Guard 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications
initialExam.description: India Post recruits Postman and Mail Guard for mail sorting, delivery, and speed post services across postal circles.
initialExam.syllabus: Part A: Maths, English, GK, Reasoning (25Q each). Part B: Regional Language.
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 100 marks, 120 minutes. Aptitude test for mail sorting.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Aptitude Test → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Postman/Mail Guard for mail delivery and sorting
initialExam.careerGrowth: Postman → Head Postman → Postal Assistant → Inspector Posts.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit indiapost.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Transport allowance, Pension
